# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  error = FALSE
)

rm(list=ls())
```

```{r load_dependencies}
# Load required packages 
if (!require(pacman)) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(here, data.table, readr, readxl, forcats, dplyr)
```

```{r}
# Initialize filenames
swl_demographics_filename <- "swal_demographics_cleaned.csv"
raine_demographics_filename <- "SLE0485-D1_data_Gen1-26_New_ID.csv"

output_swl_demographics_filename <- "swl_demographics.csv"
output_raine_demographics_filename <- "raine_demographics.csv"

# Create output directories if they don't exist
invisible(lapply(c(
  here("output", "intermediate")
), dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE))
```

# Prepare SWL demographics

```{r}
# Load SWL demographics and merge into one DataFrame
swl_demographics <- read_csv(
  here("output", "demographics", swl_demographics_filename),
  show_col_types = FALSE
  )

# Rename PID, sex, ethnicity, BMI, and self-rated health
swl_demographics <- swl_demographics %>%
  rename(pid = label,
         sex = gender,
         bmi = bmi_0m)

# Prep education
swl_demographics <- swl_demographics %>%
  mutate(
    education = case_when(
      grepl("gcse/o level", education_0m, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Basic education",
      grepl("a level|as level|other", education_0m, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Further education",
      grepl("degree", education_0m, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "University degree",
    )
  )

# Prep employment status
swl_demographics$employment <- "Employed"

# Prep smoking status
swl_demographics <- swl_demographics %>%
  mutate(
    smoking = forcats::fct_recode(
      smoking,
      "Current" = "Current",
      "Former"  = "Ex-Smoker",
      "Never"   = "Never Smoked"
    )
  )

# Prep drinking status
swl_demographics <- swl_demographics %>%
  mutate(drinking = case_when(
    alcohol == "No" ~ "Non-drinker",
    alcohol == "Yes" ~ "Drinker"
  ))

# BMI
swl_demographics$bmi_3gp <- cut(
  swl_demographics$bmi,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 25, 30, Inf),
  labels = c("<24.9", "25-29.9", "30+"),
  right = FALSE
)

# Prep prevalent CVD
cvd_cols <- c(
  "angina_0m",
  "cad_0m",
  "mi_0m",
  "cabg_angioplsty_0m",
  "tia_0m",
  "pad_claud_0m",
  "cardiacinsuff_0m"
  )

swl_demographics <- swl_demographics %>%
  mutate(
    prevalent_cvd = case_when(
      rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(cvd_cols)))) == 0 ~ NA_character_,
      rowSums(across(all_of(cvd_cols)) == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No")
    )

# Keep selected columns
cols_to_keep <-
  c(
    'pid',
    'age',
    'sex',
    'education',
    'employment',
    'smoking',
    'drinking',
    'bmi',
    'bmi_3gp',
    'prevalent_cvd'
  )

swl_demographics <- swl_demographics[, cols_to_keep]
```

# Prepare Raine demographics

```{r}
# Load Raine demographics
raine_demographics <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "demographics", raine_demographics_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
  )

# Rename pid, age, and BMI columns
raine_demographics <- raine_demographics %>%
  dplyr::rename(pid = Gen1_ID,
                age = G126_Age,
                bmi = G126_BMI) %>%
  select(-V1)

# Prep sex 
raine_demographics <- raine_demographics %>%
  mutate(
    sex = factor(
      G126_SEX,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Male", "Female")
    )
  )

# Prep education
raine_demographics <- raine_demographics %>%
  mutate(
    education = case_when(
      G126_ED33 == 0 ~ "No education",
      G126_ED33 %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Basic education",
      G126_ED33 %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Further education",
      G126_ED33 %in% c(6, 7) ~ "University degree"
    )
  )

# Prep employment status 
raine_demographics <- raine_demographics %>%
  mutate(employment = factor(if_else(
    G126_YWRK %in% c(0, 1, 2, 9), "Employed", "Not employed"
  )))

# Prep smoking
raine_demographics <- raine_demographics %>%
  mutate(
    smoking = case_when(
      G126_SM1 == 0 ~ "Never",
      G126_SM1 == 1 & G126_SM2 == 0 ~ "Former",
      G126_SM2 == 1 ~ "Current",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Prep drinking
drinking_cols <- c("G126_DK63",
                   "G126_DK64",
                   "G126_DK65",
                   "G126_DK66",
                   "G126_DK67",
                   "G126_DK68")
raine_demographics <- raine_demographics %>%
  mutate(
    drinking = case_when(
      rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(drinking_cols)))) == 0 ~ NA_character_,
      rowSums(across(all_of(drinking_cols)) > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ "Drinker",
      TRUE ~ "Non-drinker"
    )
  )

# BMI
raine_demographics$bmi_3gp <- cut(
  raine_demographics$bmi,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 25, 30, Inf),
  labels = c("<24.9", "25-29.9", "30+"),
  right = FALSE
)

# Prep prior CVD
cvd_event_cols <- c(
  "G126_CVD1",  # Angina
  "G126_CVD2",  # Claudication
  "G126_CVD5",  # Pacemaker
  "G126_CVD6",  # MI / heart attack
  "G126_CVD7",  # TIA
  "G126_CVD8",  # Stroke
  "G126_CVD9",  # Carotid surgery
  "G126_CVD10", # Coronary angioplasty / stent
  "G126_CVD11"  # Coronary bypass
)
cvd_all_cols <- c(cvd_event_cols, "G126_CVD3", "G126_CVD4", "G126_CVD12")

raine_demographics <- raine_demographics %>%
  mutate(
    prevalent_cvd = case_when(
      rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(cvd_all_cols)))) == 0 ~ NA_character_,
      rowSums(across(all_of(cvd_event_cols)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    )
  )

# Keep selected columns
cols_to_keep <-
  c(
    'pid',
    'age',
    'sex',
    'education',
    'employment',
    'smoking',
    'drinking',
    'bmi',
    'bmi_3gp',
    'prevalent_cvd'
  )

raine_demographics <- raine_demographics[, cols_to_keep]
```

# Save output files

```{r}
# Save dataframes to CSV files
out_path <- here("output", "intermediate", output_swl_demographics_filename)
write_csv(swl_demographics, out_path)
cat("SWL demographics saved to:", out_path, "\n")

out_path <- here("output", "intermediate", output_raine_demographics_filename)
write_csv(raine_demographics, out_path)
cat("Raine demographics saved to:", out_path, "\n")
```
